"""Summaries."""
import time

import anthropic
from python_wrap.llm import llm_retry

client = anthropic.Anthropic()


@llm_retry(max_attempts=4, delay=2)
def summarize(text: str) -> str:
    """Summarize text."""
    return client.messages.create(
        model="m-1",
        max_tokens=200,
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": text}],
    )
